title: AUDIO row never persisted though effect_settings_adjust routes every row through settings_save_app (carry)
evidence: main.odin:773 'case rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_AUDIO:' -> 774 'au.toggle_mute(&app.audio)' -> 778 'settings_save_app(app)'; settings.odin A11y_Settings = {palette: rnd.Palette_Mode, reduced_motion: bool, scale_step: u8} — no mute byte. The new settings_adjust_audio_effect test asserts only is_muted, no persist leg.
detail: Every adjust writes the file, but the mute toggle is not in A11y_Settings — audio resets on relaunch while sibling rows persist; the write is wasted work.
recommended_fix: Add a mute byte to A11y_Settings (bump SETTINGS_VERSION) or stop routing the audio row through the save.

title: demolish_button_rect keeps the unscaled nil-view fallback and the parity harness still calls THAT branch (carry)
evidence: popover.odin:62 'demolish_button_rect :: proc(pop: rl.Rectangle, v: ^View = nil) -> rl.Rectangle {' with the unscaled 'return {pop.x + 10, ...}' when v == nil; parity.odin:998 'btn := rnd.demolish_button_rect(pop)' — no view passed.
detail: Two geometries for one button: the app draws the scaled branch, the parity model drives the unscaled one — the exact draw/hit divergence the single-source rule exists to kill.
recommended_fix: Require the view parameter (drop the default) and pass one at parity.odin:998.

title: S cannot close the settings panel while a pipe is selected — footer copy false in that state (carry)
evidence: mouse.odin:103 'if inp.sel_pipe < 0 { if keys_n < len(keys) { keys[keys_n] = .S; keys_n += 1 } }' — collection gated on sel_pipe even when panel_open is true; the panel footer draws 'S / tap chip to close'.
detail: Opening the panel does not clear sel_pipe (exec Toggle_Settings touches only panel_open/panel_row), so the advertised keyboard close is dead exactly when a selection exists. Chip tap and pad B still work.
recommended_fix: Collect S whenever inp.panel_open regardless of sel_pipe, or fix the footer copy.

title: crisis_card_width hardcodes the forecast panel's 230/10 layout constants (carry)
evidence: crisis.odin:33 'forecast_left := v.win_w - hud(v, 230) - hud(v, 10) // the forecast panel's left edge' — duplicates forecast.odin's 'card_w := hud(v, 230)' / 'pad := hud(v, 10)'.
detail: Cross-module constant duplication: a future forecast resize silently breaks the banner clamp. Tolerable for two panels, but a shared anchor proc is cheaper than the drift risk.
recommended_fix: Extract a forecast_left_edge(v) helper in forecast.odin and call it from crisis.odin.

title: mouse_map gates the same `ui` condition twice back-to-back (carry)
evidence: mouse.odin:273 'if ui { inp.press_swallowed = true }' immediately followed by 283 'if ui { // swallowed — no tray, no drag (the base gate) } else if inp.panel_open {' ...
detail: The restored swallow gate re-tests `ui` one statement after the latch set instead of nesting — harmless but obscures the branch structure the comments describe.
recommended_fix: Merge into one if/else chain: set the latch inside the first `ui` branch.
